gui.rpg_mounts.mcmodel.step1.tooltip1: The .bbmodel is usually located somewhere in the archive.
gui.rpg_mounts.mcmodel.step1.tooltip3: We need to extract this model and open it inside Blockbench.
gui.rpg_mounts.mcmodel.step2.tooltip1: Ensure the GeckoLib plugin is installed in Blockbench.
gui.rpg_mounts.mcmodel.step2.tooltip3: Select Format: 'GeckoLib Animated Model' and click Convert.
gui.rpg_mounts.mcmodel.step3.tooltip1: Go to File -> Export -> Export GeckoLib Model.
gui.rpg_mounts.mcmodel.step4.tooltip1: Go to File -> Export -> Export GeckoLib Animations.
gui.rpg_mounts.mcmodel.step5.tooltip1: Put the exported files & texture in a separate folder.
gui.rpg_mounts.mcmodel.step5.tooltip2: Rename the folder to match the model ID (no spaces!).
gui.rpg_mounts.mcmodel.step6.tooltip1: Switch the Model Type in this GUI to GECKOLIB.
gui.rpg_mounts.mcmodel.step6.tooltip2: Set Model Path to your folder name.
gui.rpg_mounts.mcmodel.step6.tooltip3: Configure animations and enjoy your custom mount!
gui.rpg_mounts.bestiary.undiscovered: This mount has not been discovered yet. Tame or evolve it to record its details.
gui.rpg_mounts.stats.hp.tooltip: The maximum health points of this mount. If it reaches zero, the mount is knocked out.
gui.rpg_mounts.stats.stm.tooltip: The stamina capacity of this mount, consumed by sprinting, flying, and abilities.
gui.rpg_mounts.stats.lvl.tooltip: The current level of this mount, increased by gaining experience points.
gui.rpg_mounts.stats.speed.tooltip: The base land movement speed modifier for this mount.
gui.rpg_mounts.stats.swim_speed.tooltip: The base water swimming speed modifier for this mount.
gui.rpg_mounts.stats.fly_speed.tooltip: The base flying movement speed modifier for this mount.
gui.rpg_mounts.stats.jump_height.tooltip: The maximum jump height modifier for this mount.
gui.rpg_mounts.stats.recovery.tooltip: The speed at which this mount recovers its stamina when not sprinting.
gui.rpg_mounts.stats.bond.tooltip: The bonding progress with this mount. Higher bonding unlocks stats and benefits.
gui.rpg_mounts.stats.dmg_dealt.tooltip: The total damage dealt by this mount since tamed.
gui.rpg_mounts.stats.dmg_taken.tooltip: The total damage taken by this mount since tamed.
gui.rpg_mounts.stats.hp_zero.tooltip: The number of times this mount has been knocked out.
gui.rpg_mounts.stats.distance.tooltip: The total distance travelled on this mount.
gui.rpg_mounts.stats.slots.tooltip: The active abilities equipped on slot 1 and slot 2.
config.rpgmounts.tooltip.use_whitelist: If enabled, restricts mount summoning only to dimensions in the whitelist. Otherwise, blacklisted dimensions are blocked.
config.rpgmounts.tooltip.stamina_system: If enabled, mount actions (like sprinting, flying, jumping) will consume stamina, requiring periodic recovery.
config.rpgmounts.tooltip.combat_abilitie: If enabled, mounts can execute active combat abilities if they have any mapped.
config.rpgmounts.tooltip.rider_reach_mix: If enabled, extends the player's interaction and attack reach while riding a mount.
config.rpgmounts.tooltip.fall_protection: If enabled, protects the player from fall damage for a short period after dismounting.
config.rpgmounts.tooltip.culling_range_b: The distance from players at which idle client-side mounts will suspend ticking to save CPU performance.
config.rpgmounts.tooltip.reach_offset_bl: Additional attack and block reach distance in blocks given to players while riding.
config.rpgmounts.tooltip.mortality_mode: Mortality rules: Timer (summon cooldown on death), Permadeath, or Item (requires healing item on death).
config.rpgmounts.tooltip.idle_despawn_se: Time in seconds an idle mount remains in the world before automatically dismissing itself. Set to 0 to disable.
config.rpgmounts.tooltip.mount_levelling: If enabled, mounts earn experience points from travelling and fighting to increase their stats.
config.rpgmounts.tooltip.base_xp_require: The amount of experience points required for a level 1 mount to level up to level 2.
config.rpgmounts.tooltip.xp_exponent: Defines the scaling curve for subsequent mount level requirements.
config.rpgmounts.tooltip.combat_xp_dealt: Experience points gained by the mount per point of damage dealt to enemies.
config.rpgmounts.tooltip.combat_xp_taken: Experience points gained by the mount per point of damage taken from enemies.
config.rpgmounts.tooltip.riding_xp_per_s: Experience points gained by the mount per second of active riding.
config.rpgmounts.tooltip.enable_enhancer: If enabled, allows mounts to equip statistical enhancer gems.
config.rpgmounts.tooltip.max_enhancers_d: Maximum defense enhancer gems that can be equipped on a single mount.
config.rpgmounts.tooltip.max_enhancers_m: Maximum speed enhancer gems that can be equipped on a single mount.
config.rpgmounts.tooltip.max_enhancers_d: Maximum damage enhancer gems that can be equipped on a single mount.
config.rpgmounts.tooltip.max_enhancers_a: Maximum active ability enhancer gems that can be equipped on a single mount.
config.rpgmounts.tooltip.saddleless_jump: If enabled, players can jump on mounts even if they do not have a saddle equipped.
config.rpgmounts.tooltip.saddleless_spri: If enabled, players can sprint on mounts even if they do not have a saddle equipped.
config.rpgmounts.tooltip.saddle_speed_bo: The movement speed multiplier boost granted to the mount when a saddle is equipped.
config.rpgmounts.tooltip.evolution_herit: If enabled, mounts can be evolved to their advanced branches using taming items or triggers.
config.rpgmounts.tooltip.evolution_polic: Determines whether mounts retain their level, reset to level 1, or degrade a percentage of levels on evolution.
config.rpgmounts.tooltip.evolution_degra: The percentage of levels/experience lost upon evolution if the policy is set to DEGRADE.
config.rpgmounts.tooltip.chroma_mutation: If enabled, mounts have a rare chance to evolve into a chroma mutation variant with inverted colors.
The percentage probability (0.0 to 1.0) of a chroma mutation occurring during evolution.
config.rpgmounts.tooltip.environmental_t: If enabled, allows environmental factors (like biome, block category, time) to trigger evolutions.
config.rpgmounts.tooltip.summon_in_water: If enabled, allows players to summon mounts while standing/swimming in water.
config.rpgmounts.tooltip.summon_in_lava: If enabled, allows players to summon mounts while in lava.
config.rpgmounts.tooltip.summon_submerge: If enabled, mounts can be summoned or remain active while fully submerged underwater.
config.rpgmounts.tooltip.manual_dismissa: If enabled, mounts must be manually dismissed and will not automatically disappear when logging off.
config.rpgmounts.tooltip.dismiss_on_dism: If enabled, automatically dismisses the mount back to storage as soon as the rider dismounts.
config.rpgmounts.tooltip.multi_passenger: If enabled, allows mounts with passenger seats to carry multiple players or entities.
config.rpgmounts.tooltip.min_allowed_hea: The hard minimum health value allowed for any mount configuration.
config.rpgmounts.tooltip.max_allowed_hea: The hard maximum health value allowed for any mount configuration.
config.rpgmounts.tooltip.min_allowed_spe: The hard minimum land speed value allowed for any mount configuration.
config.rpgmounts.tooltip.max_allowed_spe: The hard maximum land speed value allowed for any mount configuration.
config.rpgmounts.tooltip.sprint_stamina_: Stamina points consumed per second while the mount is sprinting.
config.rpgmounts.tooltip.flight_stamina_: Stamina points consumed per second when a flying mount is gaining altitude.
config.rpgmounts.tooltip.flight_descent_: Stamina regeneration multiplier rate when a flying mount is gliding/descending.
config.rpgmounts.tooltip.bonding_buffs: If enabled, taming and riding mounts increases bonding which grants stat boosts.
config.rpgmounts.tooltip.bonding_speed_b: The movement speed multiplier boost granted when a mount reaches 100% bonding.
config.rpgmounts.tooltip.bonding_health_: The health multiplier boost granted when a mount reaches 100% bonding.
config.rpgmounts.tooltip.fall_protect_ti: The duration in seconds that dismount fall protection lasts.
config.rpgmounts.tooltip.mortality_coold: The cooldown duration in ticks (20 ticks = 1 second) before a dead mount can be summoned in Timer mode.
ability.rpg_mounts.fireproof_scales.desc: Mount and rider gain full immunity to lava and fire damage.
ability.rpg_mounts.gills_of_the_deep.des: Rider gains infinite Water Breathing while riding the mount.
ability.rpg_mounts.traction_tread.desc: Complete immunity to slow-down blocks (Soul Sand, Cobwebs, Sweet Berries).
ability.rpg_mounts.feather_light.desc: Reduces mount fall damage by 90% and decreases landing speed.
ability.rpg_mounts.rejuvenation_aura.des: Mount regenerates 0.5 HP/s; rider gets Regen I if stamina > 50%.
ability.rpg_mounts.deep_diver.desc: Swim speed increased by 40% and allows underwater sprinting.
ability.rpg_mounts.step_assist.desc: Increases step height to 1.5 blocks; walk up full blocks seamlessly.
ability.rpg_mounts.shadow_camouflage.des: Reduces mob detection range by 50% in dark areas (light level < 5).
ability.rpg_mounts.bonding_boost.desc: Increases all bonding point gains from actions by 50%.
ability.rpg_mounts.cargo_cushion.desc: Reduces stamina depletion from carrying heavy cargo by 50%.
ability.rpg_mounts.thorn_guard.desc: Reflects 20% of incoming physical damage back to attacker.
ability.rpg_mounts.photosynthesis.desc: Stamina recovery rate increased by 30% under direct sunlight.
ability.rpg_mounts.flame_breath.desc: Shoots a flame stream dealing 6 Fire damage and igniting targets.
ability.rpg_mounts.tail_sweep.desc: Deals 4 Physical damage and high knockback in a 360-degree radius.
ability.rpg_mounts.venomous_bite.desc: Deals 5 Physical damage and applies Poison II for 5 seconds.
ability.rpg_mounts.sonic_screech.desc: Deals 3 Magic damage, applying Slowness II and Weakness I in 8 blocks.
ability.rpg_mounts.thunder_stomp.desc: Deals 8 Explosive damage and stuns targets for 1.5 seconds.
ability.rpg_mounts.frost_nova.desc: Freeze wave dealing 4 Magic damage and locking targets in ice (Slowness V).
ability.rpg_mounts.blight_spit.desc: Launches acidic splash projectile dealing 5 Magic damage and Wither I.
ability.rpg_mounts.healing_touch.desc: Rejuvenates 10 HP to the mount and 4 HP to the rider.
ability.rpg_mounts.sonic_dash.desc: Dashes forward instantly, dealing 3 Physical damage to mobs hit.
ability.rpg_mounts.abyssal_stealth.desc: Mount and rider gain Invisibility & silence for 10s. attacking breaks.
ability.rpg_mounts.high_jump.desc: Propels mount 4 blocks straight up in the air.
ability.rpg_mounts.wind_glide.desc: Reduces gravity dramatically for 8s to glide across gaps.
ability.rpg_mounts.frightening_roar.desc: Forces all nearby hostile mobs to flee in terror for 6 seconds.
ability.rpg_mounts.toxic_secretions.desc: Attackers have a 30% chance to be poisoned (Poison I, 4s) on hit.
ability.rpg_mounts.glacial_aura.desc: Chills nearby enemies (within 4 blocks), reducing their speed by 15%.
ability.rpg_mounts.magnetosphere.desc: Automatically draws dropped items within 5 blocks toward the rider.
ability.rpg_mounts.night_eyes.desc: Grants the rider Night Vision when riding in dark places or at night.
ability.rpg_mounts.reinforced_hide.desc: Grants static flat damage reduction (reduces all incoming damage by 1.5).
ability.rpg_mounts.lightning_strike.desc: Summons a bolt of lightning dealing 7 Magic damage and shocking targets.
ability.rpg_mounts.spore_blast.desc: Releases blind gas cloud dealing 3 Poison damage and blinding for 4s.
ability.rpg_mounts.iron_wall.desc: Creates a temporary barrier absorbing 50% of all damage for 6 seconds.
ability.rpg_mounts.infernal_charge.desc: Dashes forward dealing 5 Fire damage and leaving trails of fire.
ability.rpg_mounts.life_steal_bite.desc: Deals 6 Physical damage, stealing 50% of damage dealt to heal mount.
ability.rpg_mounts.teleport_dash.desc: Teleports the mount forward 8 blocks, bypassing solid obstacles.
ability.rpg_mounts.glittering_dust.desc: Highlights all chests and ore containers within 16 blocks for 10s.
ability.rpg_mounts.aqua_propulsion.desc: Boosts swimming speed by 200% for 5 seconds (aquatic-only).
ability.rpg_mounts.trample.desc: Charge knock-down, dealing 4 Physical damage and applying Slowness.
ability.rpg_mounts.feather_hover.desc: Suspends mount Y-level in mid-air, allowing hovering for 5s.
ability.rpg_mounts.spider_climb.desc: Allows the mount to scale vertical walls and cliffs seamlessly on collision.
